title: Punjab Sound Systems Regulation Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Sound Systems Regulation Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT XVI OF 2018
ACT XVI OF 2018
PUNJAB SOUND SYSTEMS (REGULATION)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018.
An Act to amend the Punjab Sound Systems
(Regulation) Act, 2015
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
16th May, 2018]
No. PAP/Legis-2(189)/2018/1799, dated 16.5.2018.---The
Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) (Amendment) Bill 2018, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on May 4, 2018, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on May 16, 2018, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab Sound Systems (Regulation) Act 2015
(XVIII of 2015) for the purpose of enhancing the number of existing one
external sound system, with four such sound systems, one in each direction.
Be it enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title and
Commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the Punjab Sound Systems
(Regulation) (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Be it enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment in
section 4 of Act XVIII of 2015.---In the Punjab Sound
Systems (Regulation) Act 2015 (XVIII of 2015), in section 4, in subsection (2),
for clause (a), the following shall be substituted:
"(a) not more than four external sound systems at a place of worship
for the purpose of Azan and durood-e-pak either before or after Azan, Arabic
Khutba delivered on a Friday or on Eid prayers, announcement of death of a
person, lost or found a thing or a person; or".
